name: @thetis/ui-marketplace
description: The Extensions place of the web gateway: what needs your attention, what you have, what you could add, one card per extension family and one page per extension, and the "Updates ready" card that keeps everyone's extensions current.

thetis.label: Extensions screen
thetis.summary: The Extensions screen: add, update and remove what your assistant can do.

applyOwnChanges.help: auto or ask. auto applies the changes to your own extensions when a reply ends and nothing else is running and no terminal is open; ask shows "Changes ready" with an Apply button instead.
